principles.cold_state: Every fortified strategic site has one exact static physical/logistics blueprint. Cold sites do not own mutable stocks or damage ledgers.
principles.hot_state: A strategically active site materializes one mutable fortified-site depot owner for consumables, installed-fixture condition, water, medical reserve, wagon staging, damage and consumption history.
principles.conservation: Baseline hot-site stocks are already conserved in saved state. Runtime materialization/review transfers no campaign consumables; post-baseline replenishment and withdrawal use exact routed logistics convoys.
principles.installed_fixtures: Fixed artillery/mechanisms are part of the static fortification blueprint. Hot materialization activates mutable condition for those already-installed fixtures; it does not mint mobile equipment.
principles.demography: Fortified-site depots own stock only and must declare geography.owns_local_population=false.
principles.cold_dematerialization: A live depot may return to cold representation only after all mutable stock is transferred to an exact owner and no active damage/siege/logistics history requires the hot record.

campaign_resupply.rule: one inbound exact convoy per hot site at a time; route travel is required and review itself never teleports stock
